bars.visitor: Can a visitor to the area go to this item or book it? Give "no" only when the page shows that a visitor cannot: for example members or residents only, a private or internal meeting, or a notice that is not something to attend.
bars.traveller: Is this worth showing to a travel designer who plans a luxury trip to the area? Give "no" for routine local life that a guest would not put in an itinerary: for example a quiz night, bingo, karaoke, a club or society meeting, sport shown on a screen in a bar, a school or church fundraiser, a parkrun. Give "yes" for a festival, a market, a show or concert, an exhibition, food and wine, nature, culture, and each season or bookable experience. When in doubt, give "yes".
